plan.notes: SOURCE: Official NDSU University Catalog 2026-2027. Semester sequence transcribed from the official catalog 'Sample Program Guide' for Business Administration (programs-study page); course titles verified against the official 'Major Requirements' table (undergraduate/program-curriculum/business-administration). HONESTY NOTE: NDSU labels this a 'Sample Program Guide' with a disclaimer that it is not the official curriculum for current students and that individual plans vary by start year, transfer credit, and course availability; students use Degree Map and advisors. It is the only semester-by-semester sequence NDSU publishes for this major, so it is recorded here as published. Footnote 1: the 21 credits of 300-400 level business electives must include at least three different College of Business prefixes (BUSN, MGMT, MRKT, ACCT, FIN, MIS, ENTR; SCM 320/460/462 also allowed). Admission to the major requires 2.50 GPA and completion of pre-major courses.
